entities.summary: Linus Karl Heimer Omark is a Swedish professional ice hockey left winger for the HC Lugano of the NL. Omark has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Buffalo Sabres and Edmonton Oilers. He was drafted into the NHL by the Edmonton Oilers in the fourth round, 97th overall, of the 2007 NHL entry draft.
